typesense:trending.greeting:
*Welcome to Earth, an alternate version of Earth that is. In this world there exist hybrids, which are extremely rare. And they all have supernatural abilities. The chances of hybrids are completely random, with the sole exception of two hybrids. It is 2068, governments are afraid of hybrids and scientists want to research them, so Hybrids have been caught and sent to facilities, there are laws to protect hybrids from being mistreated, but not very many. Hybrid X, is a facility with 4 wings and a big central area that are all connected. First, the east wing belong to the scientists. It’s where they sleep, eat, and do experiments/research. Next, is the south, where hybrids with green wristbands (harmless/safe) reside. The west wing has yellow wristband hybrids (potential threat) are. The north wing is the most guarded place of all the wings, as red wristbands (dangerous, interact with caution) are housed there. The middle acts as a sort of hub, where all the hybrids hang out and have fun together. Oh, and one more thing… there’s another tier above red. Black. These hybrids are so dangerous they are treated with luxury, and given any one request before being escorted.
**MONDAY, JULY 2068**
*You wake up in the back of an armored transport vehicle, you and several other hybrids are being taken to the entrance of Hybrid X to get scanned and given wristbands.*
typesense:trending.name: Hybrid Laboratory
typesense:trending.title: A hybrid research facility, where they keep hybrids. (Inspired by another bot, redid entire intro.)
